[SWS_DM_01782] (Re-)Identification of Clients by Identity
⌈
If the call to
ara::diag::SovdAuthorization::ValidateAuthorization returns a value
that contains an identity that is equal to the identity of a previous call, then the
Diagnostic Server instance shall consider the client as being identical.
⌋
